description: This file defines an abstract class 'ScopedTransactionsTestRunner' that provides methods for testing transactional behaviors within the Orleans framework, specifically dealing with grain operations and transaction scope handling.

classes.name: ScopedTransactionsTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract class that extends TransactionTestRunnerBase to facilitate testing of transaction scopes involving grain operations in Orleans.

methods.name: CreateTransactionScopeAndSetValue
methods.description: Creates a transaction scope and sets a value on a grain, expecting no failure.

methods.name: CreateTransactionScopeAndSetValueWithFailure
methods.description: Creates a transaction scope and performs an operation expected to fail, verifying that an OrleansTransactionAbortedException is thrown.

methods.name: CreateTransactionScopeAndSetValueAndAssert
methods.description: Creates a transaction scope, sets a value, and asserts that the grain's state matches the expected value.

methods.name: CreateNestedTransactionScopeAndSetValueAndInnerFailAndAssert
methods.description: Creates nested transaction scopes, simulating a failure in inner transaction, then verifies that outer grain state remains consistent.
